required_stages.description: Global int32 scratch of P private partial histograms, shape (P, num_bins), allocated and zero-initialised inside run() on every call (device fill or in-kernel by the owning program); P bounded independently of N.

Private counting: each program owns one scratch row and counts its share of the input (single pass over the input) into that row with exact int32 updates; out-of-range values skipped; no two programs write the same row.

Cross-partial reduction: per bin, exact int32 sum of the P rows into the freshly allocated (num_bins,) int32 output; starts only after all of s2 completes (separate launch unless a grid barrier is guaranteed).

forbidden_substitutions.message: library histogram replaces the whole computation
host-side sort/scatter-based counting replaces the private-histogram kernels
conversion of the int32 input is forbidden (exact int32 path)
scratch or partial result cached across calls is forbidden
extra buffer beyond the output and the (P, num_bins) scratch

required_evidence.message: range check / output width uses num_bins

outputs.aliasing: none; a freshly allocated (num_bins,) int32 tensor on every call

timing_boundary.notes: The timed run() includes the scratch allocation and its zero fill (P * num_bins * 4 B), the counting launch with its atomic/additive updates, and the reduce launch; bytes_expr counts only the input read and output write (metric review item). No host-side sort/cast/copy of the input; no state across calls.
